title: Dalton's Atomic Theory & Limitations
notes:
Dalton's Atomic Theory (1808)

Postulates: Atoms are indivisible spheres; atoms of an element are identical; combine in fixed ratios.
Why Disregarded: Discovery of subatomic particles (e⁻, p⁺, n⁰), isotopes (same Z, diff A), isobars (diff Z, same A), and nuclear transformations.
